flavor: A hollowed-out pillar of translucent blue ice stands in the center of the chamber, its core swirling with trapped, frozen air. Beneath a layer of rime coating the floor, the outlines of silvered trinkets and leather pouches are visible through the permafrost.
name: The Frost-Locked Ossuary
reason: The party discovers a cache of supplies and valuables preserved within the ice, requiring careful extraction rather than combat.
